items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Albemarle reported third quarter results characterized by significant earnings expansion and a substantial increase in realized lithium pricing. Facing sequential pricing headwinds in lithium for Q4; Rag Udd to succeed Kent Masters as CEO on Feb. 1, 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle reports Q3 adjusted EPS $2.58, consensus $2.53
items.snippet: Reports Q3 revenue $1.6B, consensus $1.57B. Specialties improved pricing and cost progress support an additional increased outlook for the year. Global lithium demand is up 48% year-to-date through August.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
items.snippet: 2026 outlook: Energy Storage sales volumes expected 225 to 235 kilotons LCE as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset the Talison CGP3 ramp delay from a June 9 fire.
